idea-plugin.name: Flint Testing suite
idea-plugin.description:
Flint Testing Suite brings the Flint testing workflow into RustRover and other JetBrains IDEs with Rust support. It adds run configurations for running flint-steel benchmarks and serving the flint-viz visualizer directly from the IDE.

The plugin manages a local Flint toolchain setup, exposes project settings for common Flint environment variables, supports selected-tag and full-suite runs, and can refresh the Flint test index through the bundled indexer.

  • Run selected Flint tests or all benchmarks from a dedicated run configuration.
  • Launch the Flint Viz local HTTP UI from the IDE.
  • Configure flint-steel, flint-core, test paths, tags, patterns, and visualizer URLs under Tools | Flint.
